### Improved

* **Docker `:latest`** — Settings shows the real release tag (e.g. `v1.5.5.2`), not `vmain`; update with `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`
* **Docker container control** — start/stop/restart and per-app CPU/RAM auto-enable when `/var/run/docker.sock` is mounted (no manual `AMUD_DOCKER=1` required)
* **Integration stats drawer** — Prowlarr, *arr, qBit, Bazarr stats slide down on card hover without shifting the grid
* **RSS feed icons** — favicon fetched automatically from the site/feed URL (removed hardcoded source icon picker)

### Install / Upgrade

Proxmox / bare metal:

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Docker / Unraid:

```bash
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
```

Hard-refresh the dashboard (`Ctrl+Shift+R`) after upgrade. **Settings → System** should show `v1.5.5.2`.
